title: ὁ ὑπερβρέφος βάλλει
learning_goal: Practice the verb βάλλω with different prepositions: βάλλω πρός (throwing to someone) and βάλλω εἰς (throwing at someone), plus movement verbs ἔρχομαι, πίπτω, ἵστημι, ἀναβαίνω, and καθίζω.
plot: Hyperbrephos plays with balls and rocks by the tree when Glaux arrives; they play catch until Lukos appears and scares Glaux, prompting Hyperbrephos to defend his friend by throwing rocks at the wolf with increasingly cartoonish results.

frames.text: ὁ ὑπερβρέφος παίζει παρὰ τὸ δένδρον.
objects: a bright red leather ball about the size of a grapefruit
a white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit
a small gray stone that fits in one hand
a large gray boulder twice the size of Hyperbrephos
positioning: Hyperbrephos sits near the tree surrounded by his toys
The bright red leather ball rests near Hyperbrephos's right side
The white leather ball sits near Hyperbrephos's left side
The small gray stone lies within arm's reach of Hyperbrephos
The large gray boulder sits several feet away from the tree
motivations: Hyperbrephos is content and playful because he enjoys the peaceful time under the familiar shade tree

frames.artist_notes: Show the small rock stuck to or bouncing off Lukos's face with impact lines radiating outward. Lukos should have a classic cartoon 'bonk' expression with crossed eyes and his tongue hanging out slightly.

frames.artist_notes: The massive boulder should hover directly above Lukos's head with a shadow cast on him below. Draw motion lines around the rock to show it's wobbling slightly. Lukos should be frozen in terror looking straight up with his jaw dropped and eyes bulging comically, like classic Road Runner cartoons.

frames.text: ὁ ὑπερβρέφος ἀναβαίνει ἐπὶ τὸν μέγαν λίθον.

Glaux flies nearby, still holding both balls and looking pleased
Lukos is completely flattened under the massive rock with only his cartoon-style puffed head, feet, and tail visible sticking out
The large gray boulder sits heavily on top of the crushed Lukos
The bright red leather ball is held by the satisfied Glaux
The white leather ball remains with Glaux
motivations: Hyperbrephos is triumphant and climbing to claim victory over the defeated Lukos

frames.artist_notes: Lukos should be completely flattened like a pancake with only his inflated head, paws, and tail tip sticking out from under the boulder. His head should be puffed up like a balloon with swirly eyes and his tongue lolling out sideways.

frames.text: ὁ ὑπερβρέφος καθίζει ἐπὶ τῷ μεγάλῳ λίθῳ.
objects: a large gray boulder twice the size of Hyperbrephos
positioning: Hyperbrephos sits comfortably on top of the boulder like a throne, looking satisfied and relaxed
Lukos remains cartoon-flattened underneath with his puffed head, feet and tail still visible, looking dazed and sick
The large gray boulder serves as both Hyperbrephos's seat and Lukos's prison
motivations: Hyperbrephos is content and victorious because he sits on his defeated enemy like a conquering hero
Lukos is miserable and trapped because he's flattened under the heavy rock and feeling sick from the crushing
frames.artist_notes: Show Lukos's inflated parts (head, paws, tail) now deflating slightly with little 'puff' clouds coming out. His eyes should have X's or spirals, and maybe a few stars still circling his puffed head to show he's completely defeated and dizzy.
